n = int(input())

f = [0] * 182
f[1] = 1
for i in range(2, 17):
    f[i] = f[i - 1] * 10 + 1

min_cost = float('inf')

def get_abs_value(x):
    return -x if x < 0 else x

def dfs_search(level, current_cost):
    global n, min_cost
    if n == 0:
        min_cost = min(min_cost, current_cost)
        return
    if level == 0:
        return

    for i in range(-10, 11):
        change = i * f[level]
        if n + change > 0:
            n += change
            dfs_search(level - 1, current_cost + get_abs_value(i) * level)
            n -= change
            break
    for i in range(-10, 11):
        change = i * f[level]
        if n + change == 0:
            n += change
            dfs_search(level - 1, current_cost + get_abs_value(i) * level)
            n -= change
            break
    for i in range(10, -11, -1):
        change = i * f[level]
        if n + change < 0:
            n += change
            dfs_search(level - 1, current_cost + get_abs_value(i) * level)
            n -= change
            break

dfs_search(16, 0)
print(min_cost)
</translated_code>
